result.summary:
Fixed 5 one-line bugs in src (tests and tsconfig untouched); `tsc --noEmit -p . && node --test` now exits 0 with all 20 tests passing.

What was wrong:
1. src/registry.ts:17 — `versions()` sorted version strings lexicographically, so `1.9.0` ranked above `1.10.0` and the resolver's `.pop()` picked the wrong "highest" version. Now sorts with numeric `compare` (matching its doc comment).
2. src/resolver.ts:17 — the version cache was keyed by package name only, so a second range for the same package reused the first resolution. Now keyed by `name@range`, so different ranges resolve independently.
3. src/graph.ts:34-35 — a back edge reported the whole DFS path (including the prefix that led into the cycle) as the cycle. Now takes the path suffix from the first occurrence of the back-edge target before canonicalizing.
4. src/semver.ts:50 — caret with a partial 0.x range (`^0.4`) expanded to `<1.0.0` instead of `<0.5.0`. Now bumps the leftmost non-zero component (or the last given part when all are zero), matching npm semantics.
5. src/plan.ts:6 — `MS_PER_DECISECOND` was 1000; a decisecond is 100 ms, so estimates were 10x too large.

Verification: `tsc --noEmit -p . && node --test` from repo root → exit 0, 20/20 pass.
